description: Transport Data Commons (Transport Data Catalogue) is an open data portal listed in Transport Data Commons (Transport Data Catalogue), a transport data catalogue, published or maintained by Transport Data Commons (TDC) and contributing organisations such as TUMI and the Transport for Cairo, Lusaka, Kampala and Accra programmes. Transport Data Commons (Transport Data Catalogue) is a transport data catalogue of Transport Data Commons (TDC) and contributing organisations such as TUMI and the Transport for Cairo, Lusaka, Kampala and Accra programmes. Coverage: Africa. 451 datasets are listed in the catalogue that this harvest read; 75 of them are about infrastructure and became records of their own. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure and hazard data of this area. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tdc-portal.
